about: The falsifier: after the owner withdrew audit/wire/regions at epoch 268, and the forge lot's re-sign of it at 269 came in retracted at the retired at, the branch of viewsOf that read the list read nothing: 0 of the 24 lines of that scope stand. Left in, a list signed again at a fresh at would have brought back a hand-kept whitelist that refuses regions a capsule renders.
